subject: Gen7 adaptive visual motion-profile design + 100k adversarial model handoff
body: Completed bounded adaptive PresentationHinge motion-profile lane at current main 633c75be. Result: READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW as a design/input contract, but NOT READY for production integration on unchanged Core V1. Proposed learner is device-local and visual-only: aggregate completed trusted Fold7 attempts into an immutable per-attempt prior snapshot for opening duration, trusted initial acceleration/velocity, mid-fold velocity, and actual-cadence-specific presentation latency. Hard fences: exact-current attempt+generation, successful terminal, no reversal/stale generation, monotonic source+delivery timestamps, non-negative source age. Kinematics require dense trusted geometry; predicted/coarse/synthetic values never train. Presentation-latency learning additionally requires exact attempt/host receipt binding, verified timebase, valid present fence, non-janky frame, measured actual cadence, and unambiguous single-owner pipeline-lead contract. SOURCE finding: current TransitionLab timing rows lack exact attempt binding; peer causal-diagnostics HOF corroborates. Final reconciliation also consumed Manager Core V1 reviews: V1 unchanged has generation/time/lead contract gaps, including possible double lead application, so learned timing remains disabled until revision. Reference MODEL passes deterministic gates and 100,000 adversarial attempts; no physical Fold7 or CI claim. No production writes.
